title: Composition Reference
summary: Auto-derived from the real unit/trait data (src/data/units.ts, src/data/traits.ts) and the actual reroll-package logic in pickRerollTarget (src/econ/bots.ts). Trait breakpoints are hit by DISTINCT SPECIES count, not total copies or star level. A reroll core does not need to reach a breakpoint by itself — any other unit sharing the trait can be fielded once, un-rerolled, to fill it out. High-cost units are split by REAL ROLE, not cost: tanks (Fezandipiti, Mamoswine, Quagsire, Tropius, Wheezing, Latias, Tapu Fini) get carry-pairing suggestions, not "co-carry" treatment, since a tank is not a build-around-me unit. This is a reference for what is mechanically possible, not a ranked tier list — cross-check against src/econ/learnedCompositionAffinities.ts (via `npm run sim-bots`) for which of these your bots have actually found to win, and at which stage.
